name: Hitozuma Dorei Kissa 2
source:
Wild beasts lust after the body of a beautiful married woman, who manages a coffee shop. With a new sacrifice being offered to these very beasts, they will squeeze out every single drop of these two cows’ lewd tits!

[From [url=https://j-addicts.de/vn-of-the-month-december-2003/]j-addicts[/url]]
translation:
野兽们觊觎着一名经营咖啡店的美丽人妻。如今，又一个牺牲品被送到这些野兽面前。它们将从这两头母牛淫荡的乳房中榨干每一滴乳汁！

[摘自[url=https://j-addicts.de/vn-of-the-month-december-2003/]j-addicts[/url]]
